title: Defensive Network
label: nomkl
raw_output:
Defense Network is a RimWorld mod that provides new turrets, weapons, and defense systems to players. It allows them to build, expand, and command defensive positions throughout a playthrough. The mod introduces new types of drones, which can operate at high altitude and carry out patrol, interception, assault, bombing, and fire-drawing missions in place of colonists. These drones are designed for different roles and can be used to delay, suppress, or destroy enemy infantry, armor, and aircraft.

The mod also introduces new turrets and weapons platforms across several weapon families: automatic machine guns and high-rate-of-fire autocannons, large-caliber smoothbore cannons, rocket artillery and missile weapons, electromagnetic weapons, laser weapons, intelligent tracking weapons, and tactical support weapons. These weapons are designed for different target types and combat environments.

The mod also introduces new enemy types and a boss-level war machine: airborne enemies that can fly over walls, lakes, and difficult terrain, and the Landwhale, which is a massive heavy ground-effect fire-support platform and one of the most distinctive boss enemies in Defensive Network. The Landwhale is designed to be a challenging opponent for players to defeat.
